title: Compiler semantic mapping
requirement: WHEN compilation claims support for a construct, its lowering SHALL have a named semantic correspondence obligation.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: New supported program
scenarios.when: A new nested-call/list program is compiled through the public pipeline.
scenarios.then: The mapping covers returned values, defined failures, order, resource observations and applicable effects/duties; host evaluation does not supply missing circuit evidence.

expected.mapping: named semantic correspondence obligation for every supported construct used (Program, Function, Call, Match, Binary.Cons, Binary.Add, Literal, Var), each covering returned values, defined failures, order, resource observations and effects/duties
expected.evidence: host evaluation does not supply circuit evidence: constraint plan missing, correspondence unproved

unasserted: `mori compile` public command output (the simulate preparation section is the same host artifact)
